The row's contract had op/target/repo_root/limit/message and NO slot for a revision, so the sentence's own object could not reach the adapter in principle. The row now declares rev, staged and message_source; the sentence binds each of them (a stated revision verbatim, silence says so); the adapter diffs the revision it was given and refuses a revision that does not resolve; a commit stages the STATED subtree instead of sweeping the checkout and refuses a staged path outside it; a stated directory inside a repository is scoped to that repository (the first enclosing .git) with the subtree as target; and a sentence that delegates the wording ("with a clear message") gets a message composed from the staged diff instead of R13 and instead of the old invented constant. The fixture was the other half of the defect: seed_repository made ONE commit, so HEAD~1 did not exist and an honest refusal and a false pass were indistinguishable; it now seeds two commits plus a pending change.
